body: American Samoa is a US overseas territory in the Pacific Ocean, east of Fiji. For country streak purposes, it is counted as the US.
The landscape consists of green, tropical mountains with many palm trees. Small roads are often made of concrete, and houses are typically one-story with simple designs and metal sheet roofs.
A slightly rusted black truck bed can be seen on the main island of Tutuila. This is the most common vehicle as it has the most coverage.
The front of a silver-grey truck with side mirrors can be seen on Manu’a and Olosega.
On the easternmost covered island of Tau, the Google car is a glossy black truck with side mirrors visible.
A single-lane bridge with a thin wire guardrail connects the islands of Manu’a and Olosega.
Ofu Airport is small with a concrete runway. The Google Car covering it has two orange straps on the roof.
